title: free-object block props
description: Places a free object (governed custom code, for example a three.js scene) on the screen. The object lives in objects/<object>/ with its manifest, code, tests and notes. props holds values for the props the manifest declares: change them here, never in the code.
x-ai-instructions: Only when no native block can do the job, and on explicit request. Write the manifest first, then tests, then code (see skill elabora-free-objects). textAlternative must give an equivalent activity or a full description.

object.description: Free object id (folder name in objects/).

title.description: Accessible name of the embedded object.

props.description: Values of the props declared in the object manifest. Missing props use their manifest default.

a11y.description: What screen readers say about the object, worded for this block (defaults: the manifest a11y description and keyboard). Translations write here.

strings.description: Wording of the object's strings for this block (keys declared in the manifest strings; same placeholders). Required when the course language differs from the manifest language; translations write here.

enumLabels.description: Wording of the values of the object's choices for this block, as the editor shows them (defaults: the manifest x-enum-labels). Keys are props with an enum, or <prop>.<field> for a field of a list's items; each maps values of that enum to words. Translations write here.

aspectRatio.description: Shape of the frame on wide containers. auto: the object sets its height with host.requestHeight(px). fill: the frame takes the height of its layout slot.

narrowAspectRatio.description: Shape when the block is narrower than 640 px (phones, narrow slots). Typically 3:4, 2:3 or auto. Defaults to aspectRatio.

textAlternative.description: Equivalent text activity or full description, shown on demand (WCAG 1.1.1).

scored.description: Use the object's score event in the course score.
